mapper.select: SELECT event_id,enterprise_id,attempt_id,warehouse_id,event_type,operation_id,payload,delivery_payload, claim_epoch,retry_base_epoch,created_at FROM fulfillment_outbox WHERE (status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <=#{now}) OR (status='CLAIMED' AND lease_until <=#{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,event_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_outbox SET status=#{state},error_code=#{error},lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=#{next},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND claim_epoch=#{epoch} AND status='CLAIMED'
